build_cloud_build_client: build a Cloud Build client to create Docker images via GCP Cloud Build with configurable timeout and caching
upload_tar_to_storage: upload a tar.gz archive to a GCP Cloud Storage bucket for Cloud Build input
build_docker_image: build a Docker image via GCP Cloud Build from a local directory and push to Cloud Repository
build_cloud_build_request: build a Cloud Build create-build request body with kaniko or docker builder steps and options
wait_for_cloud_build: wait for a Cloud Build job to finish and return the resulting image URI or raise on failure
